steps.command: design new banner --size x-banner --headline "The web data APIs for agents" -o banner.design.json
steps.note: A new X header: the words fit the space X shows, clear of the profile picture.
steps.output:
banner.design.json  banner, x-banner 1500x500 (X header), Paper
banner.png
Check: no errors

steps.command: design revise banner.design.json "bigger headline, logo top right"
steps.note: Plain words, read by rules: larger type that re-wraps, and the logo in another corner.
steps.output:
banner.design.json  banner, x-banner 1500x500 (X header), Paper
  headline 20% bigger
  logo top right
banner.png

steps.command: design revise banner.design.json "darker theme, add a badge \"New\""
steps.note: The next darker theme of the brand, and a label in its own chip.
steps.output:
banner.design.json  banner, x-banner 1500x500 (X header), Blue
  theme Blue
  badge "New"
banner.png

steps.command: design revise banner.design.json "make the logo neon green"
steps.note: Off brand: refused, nothing changes, and it says why.
steps.output:
Nothing was changed.
"make the logo neon green": Colors outside the brand palette are refused. The palette: #FFFFFF, #2563EB, #000000, #F2F2F2, #07142F, #D3E0FB, #191919, #595959, #666666, in the themes Paper, Blue, Ink, Mist, Night, Graphite.
Things you can say here: hide the logo; show the logo; reset the logo. Copy goes in quotes. For exact edits use `design edit`.

steps.command: design revise banner.design.json "body \"Search, scrape and crawl the live web from one API\""
steps.note: A line under the headline; the layout makes room.
steps.output:
banner.design.json  banner, x-banner 1500x500 (X header), Blue
  body "Search, scrape and crawl the live web from one API"
banner.png
Check: no errors

steps.note: Undo takes back the last change exactly.
steps.output:
banner.design.json  banner, x-banner 1500x500 (X header), Blue
  undid: body "Search, scrape and crawl the live web from one API"
banner.png
Check: no errors
